The rigid structures of the gondola and the vertical ladder/framework appear slightly 'mushy' or ill-defined. The lines of the rigging do not maintain perfect straightness and seem to blend into the background or each other, suggesting minor structural incoherence typical of AI generation.

To verify the spatial relationship between the suspended gondola and the hull, ensuring the rigging has correct depth and doesn't float unnaturally.
